causes.label: demand
causes.quote: First, demand across both regions was collectively up to 870 MW greater than forecast.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Second, a unit at Loy Yang A tripped, removing 560 MW of capacity priced at the floor from the market.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Finally, with light wind conditions, the output of wind generation was around 3200 MW lower than what is installed across both regions and up to 122 MW lower than forecast earlier in the day.
